articles.headline: China targets film and video creators with AI subsidies to build its AI ecosystem
articles.summary: China is using subsidies, discounted office space, and computing resources to attract creators and startups into its AI push. For businesses, this signals stronger state support for AI content tools and more competition for compute, talent, and local market share in media-adjacent AI.

articles.headline: South Korea’s 10% data breach fines raise global compliance pressure
articles.summary: South Korea’s tougher data-breach penalties are pushing firms toward stronger prevention controls and more conservative compliance practices. Multinational businesses may need to build to the strictest global standard to avoid fragmentation, higher legal risk, and costly policy mismatches.

articles.headline: Oracle layoffs reflect pressure to fund AI chips and data centers
articles.summary: Oracle’s latest layoffs appear tied to the company’s effort to redirect spending toward AI infrastructure, including chips and data centers. For customers and suppliers, that points to continued cost discipline, shifting investment priorities, and possible changes in enterprise cloud planning.
